the knowledge of the parallel execution plan of Spark applications can help improve the accuracy of the prediction of the execution duration and, consequently, the dynamic allocation of resources.
the parallel execution plan of Spark applications is not unique and that the knowledge about the execution plans can help improve the accuracy of the estimation techniques.
